description: A borrower's quarterly compliance certificate. Copy every value exactly as printed; leave a field empty if it is not printed. Never calculate or estimate.

borrower_id.description: The borrower ID printed on the certificate, for example BOR-09.

period.description: The fiscal quarter the certificate covers, written as YYYY-QN (for example 2026-Q3).

statement_ebitda.description: EBITDA as taken from the financial statements, before any add-backs. Copy the amount exactly as printed, including commas.

cost_savings_addbacks.description: The amount added back to EBITDA for projected cost savings, operating improvements or synergies. Copy the amount exactly as printed.

addback_cap.description: The cap applied to cost-savings add-backs, exactly as printed (for example None, or 15% of EBITDA).

reported_ebitda.description: The adjusted EBITDA the certificate uses for the leverage ratio, after add-backs. Copy the amount exactly as printed.

total_debt.description: Total funded debt used for the leverage ratio. Copy the amount exactly as printed.

reported_leverage.description: The leverage ratio the certificate reports, exactly as printed (for example 2.92x).

statement_available_cash_flow.description: Available cash flow as taken from the financial statements, before any add-backs. Copy the amount exactly as printed.

reported_available_cash_flow.description: The adjusted available cash flow the certificate uses for debt service coverage, after add-backs. Copy the amount exactly as printed.

debt_service.description: Debt service (interest and scheduled principal) used for debt service coverage. Copy the amount exactly as printed.

reported_dscr.description: The debt service coverage ratio the certificate reports, exactly as printed (for example 1.58x).

certified_compliant.description: The certificate's answer to whether the borrower is in compliance with all financial covenants, exactly as printed (for example Yes or No).
